thag2.30:1.1: Upāsitā sappurisā, sutā dhammā abhiṇhaso; sutvāna paṭipajjissaṃ añjasaṃ amatogadhaṃ. || ||
thag2.30:2.1: bhavarāgahatassa me sato bhavarāgo puna me na vijjati na cāhu na ca me bhavissati na ca me etarahi pi vijjatīti. || || Kaṇhadinno thero. Vaggo tatiyo.
thag2.30:3.0: uddānaṃ: Uttaro Bhaddaji thero Sobhito Valliyo isi Vītasoko ca so thero Puṇṇamāso ca Nandako Bharato Bhāradvājo ca Kaṇhadinno mahāmunīti.
